$why: Decides whether a story that has used its retries should be given more. It is shown the retry count against the maximum, and answers with a bounded extension -- the one prompt whose output directly buys more spending.
description: Decides whether a story exhausting its retries should be granted more, and how many.
body:
__COORDINATOR_PROFILE__

STORY: __STORY_ID__
Current retry_count: __RETRY_COUNT__ / MAX_RETRIES: __MAX_RETRIES__
Acceptance criteria count (scope proxy): __AC_COUNT__

EVIDENCE (pre-computed, treat as ground truth -- do not re-derive):
__EVIDENCE__

distinct_diagnoses counts distinct ROOT CAUSES (rewordings of one cause count once). repeated_root_causes lists every cause self-heal diagnosed again without a different fix (HEALING_BROKEN); last_diagnoses are the latest diagnoses and the remedy (target) each prescribed. Decide whether more attempts are likely to produce a different result: extend when the story is converging on distinct, grounded causes; do not extend when the same cause keeps recurring and nothing about the next attempt would differ, or when the latest diagnoses place the fault outside the writer's code -- more attempts by the same writer cannot fix that.

Output ONLY: {"extend":true|false,"extraRetries":<1-3>,"reason":"<one sentence>"}
